coverageNotes: Reads generated built-in URL properties. Does not cover hosted networking, webhook handling or arbitrary environment-variable management. App-name fallback is shared implementation behavior.

questions.concept: Read built-in deployment URLs through generated env
questions.question: Which fields should replace `URL_FIELDS`?

options.rationale: These platform properties are already generated and point to the distinct HTTP actions and client endpoints.
Both properties exist, but their endpoint roles are swapped.
Hostname substitution leaves the local client port unchanged and returns the wrong site URL.
CONVEX_URL is not the typed server env property; CONVEX_CLOUD_URL is.
